resources.string: Blocks WhatsApp chats from specific contacts by matching their WhatsApp avatar hash when available and falling back to on-screen name detection.
Android 11+: tap the camera icon next to a blocked contact, then open that chat in WhatsApp so the service can enroll its profile picture hash.
Now open %1$s's chat in WhatsApp to enroll the avatar hash.
Couldn't enroll %1$s's avatar. Try again with the chat header fully visible.
Avatar enrollment needs Android 11 (API 30) or newer.
Enable the accessibility service before enrolling an avatar.
